Resolves #3241

Adds drag-and-drop column resizing support to `Neo.table.header.Toolbar` and `Neo.table.header.Button` via `Neo.table.header.plugin.Resizable` (`ntype: 'plugin-table-header-resizable'`). Each `table-header-button` lazy-loads `src/table/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs` when `resizable: true` (configurable per button or via `Neo.table.header.Toolbar#resizable_`), updates `width` and `<th>` `wrapperStyle` (`width`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth`) live during `onDragMove`, cleans temporary proxy coordinates and recalculates sticky `dock` (`left`/`right`) offsets via `Toolbar#updateDockOffsets()` / `Toolbar#passSizeToBody()` on `onDragEnd`, and prevents resize gestures from triggering header sort clicks or column reorder drags (`ignoreDragSelector: '.neo-resizable'`).

Evidence: L3 (real-pointer Playwright E2E in `test/playwright/e2e/table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs` + unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/table/header/Resizable.spec.mjs`) → L1 required (no structured runtime-only ACs on #3241).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #3241.

|---|---|

| `resources/scss/src/table/header/Button.scss`, `Toolbar.scss`, `Container.scss` | Covered by `test/playwright/e2e/table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs` & `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json` regeneration |

## Deltas from ticket
- Added `Toolbar#updateDockOffsets()` (shared by `createItems()` and `passSizeToBody()`) to recalculate sticky `left` / `right` offsets on docked (`dock: 'left' | 'right'`) header `<th>` cells and refresh `table.Body` rows when docked columns are resized.
- Scoped the default `min-width: 200px` in `resources/scss/src/table/Container.scss` from `td, th` to `th` so inline `minWidth`/`width` on resized `<th>` elements can narrow table columns down to `minWidth: 100`.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] Verify interactive column resize drag behavior in table examples (`test/playwright/e2e/table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs`).
